Confidence: facts restated from a single explicit page sentence are high confidence; nothing in this section was taken from memory or from a non-issuer source.
Precision rule: ages, waiting periods, hour totals, validity terms, vision minimums, test counts and thresholds, and the named forms are kept exactly as printed, with the wording paraphrased so no learner line copies the manual.
Accuracy flags: none; the teen-parent guidance, test paragraphs and driver education rules on physical pages six to eight extracted readably, and no page in the range was unreadable.
Stability: the manual is one dated edition; any rule a later law or edition changes must be re-read from the current manual before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published licensing rules for exam preparation only.
